program_description: a coordinator hands one batch per round to 4 workers and waits for all of them; worker-2 commits results under cache_lock, which a flusher thread also takes every round
fault_summary: the flusher holds cache_lock across a 40 ms sleep every round; worker-2 blocks on cache_lock (futex) and every round waits for worker-2 (batch_server <- worker-2 <- flusher <- timer)

threads.name: watchdog
threads.role: ends the run if the program does not end itself

threads.name: flusher
threads.role: writes back the previous batch under cache_lock every round
